description: Full-stack event discovery platform for attendees and comprehensive event management admin dashboard for organizers.

tech_stack.frontend: React.js with Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Sonner toast
tech_stack.backend: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL with REST API
tech_stack.auth: JWT authentication with demo admin credentials

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust Node.js + Express + Postgres backend with JWT auth and event CRUD endpoints, and a React frontend featuring Event Discovery (search, filters, sorting, pagination, details view, featured carousel) and an Admin Dashboard (JWT login, event management table, create/edit modal, publish/unpublish toggle, feature toggle). Ensure all interactive elements include data-testid attributes.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST NOT apply universal transition like transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Every interactive element must have hover, focus, and active states.
All interactive elements and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers or overlays.
